thread:
Ana: FYI — last night we got a big burst of pages from gpu-cluster-eu (about 30 alerts in ~20m). Most looked like short spikes tied to a storage controller flapping.
Jesse: yep saw that, oncall had 3 real wakeups. The rest were noise. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/GPUs/gpu-cluster-eu?view=last24h :grimacing:
Sophie: suggestion — we should stop paging for every single transient gpu_util spike. Propose: only page if sustained > 4m OR if node_count_affected >= 3. Otherwise create a ticket.
Cheng: agree. Also think we should add a nightly quiet window (23:00-06:00 UTC) where non-critical pages are converted to tickets unless they meet escalation criteria. That would reduce pager fatigue for oncall in low-impact hours.
Ana: +1. We still need fast escalation for things that actually affect SLO. Maybe tie to pod_oom_count or inference_error_rate > 0.5% over 5m.
Sophie: here's a draft Prometheus rule to use as a starting point:
```yaml
alert: GPUUtilHigh_Sustained
expr: avg_over_time(gpu_util{env=\"prod\"}[4m]) > 95
for: 4m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: \"Sustained GPU utilization >95% (4m)\"
  runbook: \"https://runbook.redwood.io/gpu-util-high\"
```
Ana: and a companion rule for noisy spikes that should ticket:
```yaml
alert: GPUUtilHigh_Transient
expr: avg_over_time(gpu_util{env=\"prod\"}[2m]) > 95 and avg_over_time(gpu_util{env=\"prod\"][4m]) <= 95
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: ticket
annotations:
  summary: \"Transient GPU util spike (<4m) — auto-ticket\"
```
Jesse: For grouping we should group by cluster and failure class (node_id or io_controller). Alertmanager can group on `cluster, failure_reason` so we don't flood with one alert per pod.
Cheng: Alertmanager mute_time_intervals config for quiet window example: `23:00-06:00 UTC` + route that downgrades severity to `ticket` unless label `escalate=true` is set.
alertmanager-bot: automated note — current route set: `severity=page` -> immediate page; `severity=ticket` -> create ticket in PagerDuty queue 'SRE-Tickets' (non-paging). Will need update if we change labels.
Ana: Decision items: 1) Move GPUUtilHigh transient -> ticket by default. 2) Only page for sustained >4m or node_count_affected>=3 OR pod_oom_count>0 OR inference_error_rate>0.5% over 5m. 3) Add quiet window 23:00-06:00 UTC to downgrade non-critical pages. 4) Grouping on cluster+failure_reason.
Sophie: owners: I'll draft PR for Prometheus rules and test in staging (assign to @Cheng for review). Jesse will update Alertmanager routing + mute windows. Ana will own monitoring runbook edits.
Cheng: timeline — PR by EOD Friday, testing next week, staged change to alertmanager in canary, then full rollout. If anyone is blocked ping me.
Jesse: also check cost implications — throttling pager noise reduces ops load (and we might reduce oncall quick-response budget). Not a direct infra cost but saves human-hours.
Ana: one more: add a Grafana panel for 'alerts suppressed by quiet window' so we can see how many incidents were downgraded. Sophie can add to SRE dashboard.
Sophie: will do.
Jesse: SGTM. :thumbsup:
Cheng: cool — I'll create the alertmanager PR template with the new mute interval and escalation rules.
Ana: thanks team. We'll reconvene after the staged rollout. :white_check_mark:
